meta.name: docx
meta.description: Use this skill whenever the user wants to create, read, edit, or manipulate Word documents (.docx files) or Word templates (.dotx files). Triggers include: any mention of 'Word doc', 'word document', '.docx', '.dotx', or requests to produce professional documents with formatting like tables of contents, headings, page numbers, or letterheads. Also use when extracting or reorganizing content from .docx or .dotx files, inserting or replacing images in documents, performing find-and-replace in Word files, working with tracked changes or comments, or converting content into a polished Word document. If the user asks for a 'report', 'memo', 'letter', 'template', or similar deliverable as a Word or .docx file, use this skill. Do NOT use for PDFs, spreadsheets, Google Docs, or general coding tasks unrelated to document generation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline_en: Create and edit formatted Word documents.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 可以新建、读取、编辑 Word 文档(.docx/.dotx):新建时生成 docx 文件,编辑时改内部 XML,读取时转成文本,还会把结果转成图片核对版式。
howto.when: 当用户提到“Word doc”、“.docx”等关键词,或要求生成报告、备忘录等 Word 文件,或要求提取内容、插入图片、处理修订和批注时触发。

say.text: 把这份报告转成 Word 文档,加目录和页码。
say.note: 会新建 docx 并按要求排版。

say.text: 把这个 docx 文件里的“费用”全部改成“成本”。
say.note: 执行查找替换并生成新文件。

say.text: 帮我把这个 Word 文档中的插图替换掉,并接受所有修订。
say.note: 会编辑 XML、处理图片和修订。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can create, read, and edit Word documents (.docx/.dotx): it generates .docx files, edits internal XML for existing files, converts content to text for reading, and renders results as images to check layout.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user mentions 'Word doc', '.docx', etc., asks for a report, memo, or similar as a Word file, or requests extracting content, inserting images, or handling tracked changes/comments.

say_en.text: Turn this report into a Word document with a table of contents and page numbers.
say_en.note: Creates a .docx and formats it as requested.

say_en.text: Replace every 'fees' with 'costs' in this docx file.
say_en.note: Runs find-and-replace and saves a new file.

say_en.text: Replace the images in this Word document and accept all tracked changes.
say_en.note: Edits XML, handles images and revisions.
